records.title: The GUM Corpus: Creating Multilayer Resources in the Classroom
records.verified_scope:
Pinned Git tree and README, annotation inventory, license, actual XML and rs4 lines inspected; academic example includes title and author blocks in

.
records.unit: document, marked paragraph and sentence; EDU and hierarchical relation
records.genres_or_forms: 16 main text types include academic, essays, how-to, news, legal court; eight extra challenge genres
records.annotation_or_metrics_available: Original 32 eRST relation labels, EDU IDs/text/parent/relname, secondary edges, signals; XML p/s/head and source metadata; distinct layers.
records.size_and_count_basis: 301 rs4 files counted from pinned Git tree 1d999e5a0327ecb83015007774f6a9be23ecbc41: 275 main plus 26 challenge; 18 academic, 14 essay, 19 how-to; file count, not complete works.
records.human_or_automatic: Human annotated eRST; other layers may be automatic or corrected; inspect layer provenance.
records.reliability: eRST signal agreement separately in DC02; not agreement on paragraph roles.
records.source_text_rights: Per genre and document: academic CC BY 4.0, essays CC BY-NC-SA 4.0, wikiHow CC BY-NC-SA 3.0; Reddit subject to terms and text reconstruction.
records.access_status: public files; Reddit omitted, reconstruction required
records.reuse_recommendation: Pin tree, export original p/s/text plus graph linked by token alignments, retaining IDs and exclusion tags for metadata and incomplete texts.
records.project_feature_mapping: F02/F04/F05/F08 and F09 relation evidence; F01 only after completeness audit.
records.limitations: No automatic equivalence between a relation and paragraph reader job. XML p includes author lines; GUM source extracts are not necessarily complete works. Genre labels are broad.

records.title: eRST: A Signaled Graph Theory of Discourse Relations and Organization
records.verified_scope: Paper methods/agreement passages and actual rs4 segment relations inspected.
records.unit: EDU, text span, graph edge, signal
records.annotation_or_metrics_available: 32 types including explanation-evidence, adversative-concession, elaboration-attribute, purpose-goal; edge nuclearity and signal types.
records.size_and_count_basis: GUM double-annotation experiment 36 documents 32K tokens; secondary edges initial 24-document dev experiment.
records.reliability: Signal recognition mutual F1 92.3 and association 90 on 36 docs; secondary-edge attachment/nuclearity/relation .311/.279/.223 initially. Different tasks, no role agreement.
records.reuse_recommendation: Reuse relation inventory and segmentation guide directly to identify discourse links; retain both endpoints and confidence/disagreement.
records.project_feature_mapping: F09 relation layer and F07 evidence link as testable hypothesis
records.limitations: Evidence relation connects spans; it does not establish citation quality, reader-job identity, or a paragraph function.

records.title: GDTB: Genre Diverse Data for English Shallow Discourse Parsing across Modalities, Text Types, and Domains
records.verified_scope: Methods/evaluation and actual relations TSV header/rows inspected.
records.unit: two argument spans, relation type and sense, connective
records.annotation_or_metrics_available: TSV doc, unit token bounds/text, rel_type, orig_label and coarse label; sampled implicit expansion.conjunction and explicit contingency.cause.result.
records.size_and_count_basis: 2024 paper corrected test 1,531 relation instances; current release extent can differ.
records.human_or_automatic: Semi-automatic conversion from gold GUM RST, targeted manual correction; test set fully corrected. Not wholly independent annotations.
records.reliability: Automatic vs corrected test exact label/span/type micro F1 0.9218; 8 test documents double coded implicit senses kappa .77 level 3, .83 level 2; does not validate reader roles.
records.reuse_recommendation: Compare original eRST and shallow senses on same texts; use manually corrected test as higher-confidence subset.
records.project_feature_mapping: F09 links and F07 potential support
records.limitations: Source layers are dependent; gold directory naming does not prove every record manually independently coded.

records.title: AMALGUM – A Free, Balanced, Multilayer English Web Corpus
records.verified_scope: README, sampling claims, license, actual rs3 relation header inspected.
records.baseline_status: known-baseline lead, new file and license inspection
records.unit: document excerpts, EDU and automatically inferred relations
records.genres_or_forms: 8 web-source genres incl MDPI academic, wikiHow, news and fiction
records.annotation_or_metrics_available: Automatic segmentation, POS, dependency, coreference, RST in rs3, XML etc.

records.title: Disagreements in analyses of rhetorical text structure: A new dataset and first analyses

records.human_or_automatic: Two trained human annotators; correction for obvious violations in some corpora.
records.reliability: Shared EDU boundaries intentionally isolate tree disagreements; cannot evaluate independent segmentation reliability.

records.annotation_license: CC BY-SA 4.0 per README; check underlying source
records.source_text_rights: WSJ absent, LDC license; other source-specific rights require review
records.access_status: Public rs3, Tace outputs; WSJ licensed
records.reuse_recommendation: Reproduce disagreement categories; preserve alternatives rather than forcing adjudication; compare boundary reliability separately.

records.title: Penn Discourse Treebank Version 3.0
records.verified_scope: LDC catalog and manual entry inspected.
records.baseline_status: new detailed access and scheme inspection
records.unit: discourse connective and two argument spans
records.annotation_or_metrics_available: Explicit and implicit discourse relations and senses; v3 extends v2. DiscAlign aligns PDTB 2.0 with RST-DT.
